name: Be Mine
story: A tender invitation to be remembered.
Bright citrus opens, then rose and white florals take their time.
A soft tonka warmth settles close to the skin.
Made for the hours when nobody else is in the room.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene, Benzyl Salicylate, Citronellol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Coumarin, Citral

name: Vibe
story: Made for the rhythm of now.
Sparkling lemon meets rosy florals and a turn of clove.
The sweetness underneath keeps it moving.
Day into night, without changing a thing.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Citronellol, Linalool, Coumarin, Limonene, Amyl Cinnamyl Alcohol, Geraniol, Eugenol, Citral, Farnesol

name: Pride of Arabia
base: Soft powdery violet and woody undertone
story: Inspired by the confidence and heritage of Arabia.
Citrus and green violet leaf open clean and unhurried.
Violet, muguet and rose gather in the middle.
A soft powdery wood carries it, quietly grand.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Geraniol, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Limonene, Methyl-2-Octynoate, Hydroxy Citronellal, Citronellol, Citral

name: Suit Up
story: The finishing touch before you step out.
Crisp citrus, then rose turned warm with cinnamon and clove.
Tonka underneath, polished rather than sweet.
For the entrance you only get to make once.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Coumarin, Limonene, Citronellol, Eugenol, Cinnamal, Citral, Geraniol, Isoeugenol

name: The Writer
story: A fragrance for stories that linger after the last page.
Luminous lemon opens, then rose and clove spice.
Warm balsamic amber settles in and stays.
Thoughtful, unhurried, quietly magnetic.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Citronellol, Linalool, Geraniol, Farnesol, Limonene, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzyl Cinnamate, Isoeugenol, Citral

name: Edward the Black Prince
story: Dark, noble and commanding.
Bright citrus cuts through aromatic lavender and clove.
Warm spice closes in behind it.
A trail that announces itself, then holds its tongue.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Eugenol, Limonene, Linalool, Isoeugenol

name: Amore
story: A celebration of love in all its warmth.
Lemon-bright freshness opens the door.
Aromatic florals and clove fill the room.
It finishes softly spiced, and lingers longer than expected.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Limonene, Linalool, Isoeugenol, Citral, Eugenol

name: Soleil Frais
story: Like cool sunlight on a clear morning.
Clean lemon and bright citrus, and very little else.
Nothing heavy, nothing asking for attention.
The one you reach for when the day is already warm.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Limonene

name: Barcelona
story: A tribute to a city alive with colour, art and late-night energy.
Citrus opens sharp, the way the light does there.
Aromatic florals and rose fill the middle.
A gentle sweetness carries it into the evening.
ing: Denatured Ethyl Alcohol, Aqua, Parfum, Linalool, Coumarin, Limonene, Geraniol, Citral
